                           THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD









                              ALBANY, NEW YORK

                              January 22, 2001

                                  3:13 p.m.





                               REGULAR SESSION







                 LT. GOVERNOR MARY O. DONOHUE, President

                 STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary



















                                                          127



                            P R O C E E D I N G S

                             THE PRESIDENT:    The Senate will

                 come to order.

                             I ask everyone present to please

                 rise and repeat with me the Pledge of

                 Allegiance.

                             (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

                 the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

                             THE PRESIDENT:    With us today to

                 give the invocation is the Reverend Peter G.

                 Young, from Blessed Sacrament Church in Bolton

                 Landing.

                             REVEREND YOUNG:    Let us pray.

                             Dear God, as we experience the

                 winter weather, we gather to assist the

                 elderly and needy who are attempting to stay

                 comfortably warm and flu-free.  As

                 Californians suffer without sufficient power,

                 we thank You, O God, for Your great gifts of

                 hydroenergy resources here in New York State.

                             With that gratitude and attitude of

                 gratitude, we thank You for allowing us to

                 live in this great Empire State that enjoys

                 such creative beauty and richness that You now

                 have shared with all of Your New York State





                                                          128



                 citizens.

                             Amen.

                             THE PRESIDENT:    Reading of the

                 Journal.

                             THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,

                 Saturday, January 20, the Senate met pursuant

                 to adjournment.  The Journal of Friday,

                 January 19, was read and approved.  On motion,

                 Senate adjourned.

                             THE PRESIDENT:    Without

                 objection, the Journal stands approved as

                 read.

                             Presentation of petitions.

                             Messages from the Assembly.

                             Messages from the Governor.

                             Reports of standing committees.

                             The Secretary will read.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Senator Volker,

                 from the Committee on Codes, reports the

                 following bills:

                             Senate Print 403, by Senator

                 Skelos, an act to amend the Penal Law;

                             430, by Senator DeFrancisco, an act

                 to amend the Criminal Procedure Law;

                             435, by Senator DeFrancisco, an act





                                                          129



                 to amend the Criminal Procedure Law;

                             437, by Senator DeFrancisco, an act

                 to amend the Penal Law;

                             490, by Senator Marcellino, an act

                 to amend the Penal Law;

                             542, by Senator Padavan, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             662, by Senator Goodman, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             684, by Senator Goodman, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             685, by Senator Goodman, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             694, by Senator Goodman, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             700, by Senator Goodman, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             851, by Senator Balboni, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             852, by Senator Balboni, an act to

                 amend the Penal Law;

                             853, by Senator Balboni, an act to

                 amend the Civil Rights Law;

                             And 861, by Senator Balboni, an act

                 to amend the Penal Law.





                                                          130



                             All bills ordered direct to third

                 reading.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Without

                 objection, all bills direct to third reading.

                             Reports of select committees.

                             Communications and reports from

                 state officers.

                             Motions and resolutions.

                             Senator Skelos.

                             SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President, I

                 believe there's a privileged resolution at the

                 desk by Senator Connor.  May we please have

                 the title read and move for its immediate

                 adoption.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The

                 Secretary will read.

                             THE SECRETARY:    By Senator

                 Connor, Legislative Resolution commemorating

                 the Asian American community's celebration of

                 the Lunar New Year, 4699, the Year of the

                 Snake, on January 24, 2001.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The

                 question is on the resolution.  All those in

                 favor signify by saying aye.

                             (Response of "Aye.")





                                                          131



                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Opposed,

                 nay.

                             (No response.)

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The

                 resolution is adopted.

                             Senator Skelos.

                             SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President,

                 Senator Connor's bill, which involves Chinese

                 New Year's, he's agreed to open that up for

                 sponsorship.  So if anybody would like to be

                 on that resolution, they should notify the

                 desk.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Anyone

                 desiring to cosponsor the resolution, please

                 notify the desk.

                             SENATOR SKELOS:    Mr. President.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Senator

                 Skelos.

                             SENATOR SKELOS:    If we could take

                 up the noncontroversial calendar, please.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The

                 Secretary will read the noncontroversial

                 calendar.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 4, by Senator Skelos, Senate Print 77, an act





                                                          132



                 to amend the Civil Practice Law and Rules, in

                 relation to commencement of special

                 proceedings.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 5.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 43.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 7, by Senator Marcellino, Senate Print 103, an

                 act to amend the Criminal Procedure Law, in

                 relation to anonymous juries.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 4.  This

                 act shall take effect on the 30th day.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 47.





                                                          133



                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 8, by Senator Skelos, Senate Print 126, an act

                 to amend the Civil Practice Law and Rules, in

                 relation to the time to take an appeal.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 4.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 46.  Nays,

                 1.  Senator Paterson recorded in the negative.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 11, by Senator Volker, Senate Print 137, an

                 act to amend the Penal Law and the Criminal

                 Procedure Law, in relation to the offenses of

                 bail jumping.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 16.  This





                                                          134



                 act shall take effect on the first day of

                 November.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 47.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 13, by Senator Volker, Senate Print 205, an

                 act to amend the Criminal Procedure Law, in

                 relation to appeals from certain orders of

                 suppression.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 50.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 18, by Senator Volker, Senate Print 216, an





                                                          135



                 act to amend the Criminal Procedure Law, in

                 relation to sealing and other dispositions of

                 records.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Read the

                 last section.

                             THE SECRETARY:    Section 3.  This

                 act shall take effect on the first day of

                 November.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Call the

                 roll.

                             (The Secretary called the roll.)

                             THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 50.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The bill

                 is passed.

                             Senator Velella, that concludes the

                 calendar.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Mr. President,

                 is there any housekeeping at the desk?

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    No,

                 there is not, Senator.  Nothing.

                             I'm sorry, Senator Dollinger is

                 asking -

                             SENATOR DOLLINGER:    Mr.

                 President, may I have unanimous consent to be

                 recorded in the negative on Calendar Number 8.





                                                          136



                             Thank you.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Without

                 objection, Senator Dollinger will be recorded

                 in the negative on Calendar 8.

                             Senator Duane.

                             SENATOR DUANE:    Thank you.  Mr.

                 President, with unanimous consent, could I be

                 recorded in the negative on Calendar Numbers 8

                 and 18.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Without

                 objection, Senator Duane will be recorded in

                 the negative on Calendars 8 and 18.

                             Senator Velella.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Mr. President,

                 Senator Bruno, in consultation with the

                 Minority Leader, hands up the following

                 committee changes for filing.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Those

                 will be received at the desk and filed.

                             Senator Velella.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Mr. President,

                 may we please return to the order of motions

                 and resolutions.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Motions

                 and resolutions.





                                                          137



                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Mr. President.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Senator

                 Velella.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    On behalf of

                 Senator Bruno, I offer up the following notice

                 of intention to alter the Senate rules and ask

                 that it be filed in the Journal.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    The

                 notice will be received and filed in the

                 Journal.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Mr. President,

                 there being no further business, I move we

                 adjourn -- I'm sorry.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    I'm

                 sorry.  Senator Montgomery.

                             SENATOR MONTGOMERY:    Yes, Mr.

                 President, I would like unanimous consent to

                 be recorded in the negative on Calendar

                 Numbers 11 and 18.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    Without

                 objection, Senator Montgomery will be recorded

                 in the negative on Calendars 11 and 18.

                             Senator Velella.

                             SENATOR VELELLA:    Now, Mr.

                 President, there being no further business, I





                                                          138



                 move we adjourn until Tuesday, January 23rd,

                 at 11:00 a.m.

                             ACTING PRESIDENT MEIER:    On

                 motion, the Senate stands adjourned until

                 Tuesday, January 23rd, at 11:00 a.m.

                             (Whereupon, at 3:21 p.m., the

                 Senate adjourned.)
